note: Ingest windows, fiducial settings and SQI flags for device recordings (docs/data_convention.md section 4, docs/protocol/device_session_pipeline.md). Proposed 2026-11-13, pending review. SQI thresholds are copies of the proposals in docs/protocol/sqi_specification_v1.md and stay unlocked until G2; nothing here was chosen on BP or on any device recording.

sources.window: Protocol v0.3 section 6.2: 60 s stored before t0; sensitivity windows 10/20/30/60 s; primary 30 s is the proposal of sqi_specification_v1.md section 2, to be locked on the pilot.
sources.pat_ppg_color: Slot 1 (green on V1) is the time origin of the PPG slots (Packet Schema V0.1 section 7), so its PAT does not depend on the LED_PW spacing. Choice of colour for PAT is not locked; proposal 2026-11-13, pending review. Features are computed for every colour.
sources.signal: Defaults of features-sqi-v1/v2 (software/signal_processing/fiducials.py SignalConfig), unchanged; every value is in seconds, so nothing depends on 125 Hz. The rate comes from the data (ECG 512, PPG 200 sps).
sources.pat_validity: Same values as configs/data/week05_fiducials.json (pat-validity-v1). mad_floor_ms 10 ms stays above the PPG sample period at 200 sps (5 ms).
sources.sqi_hardware: sqi_specification_v1.md section 3.3: ADC saturation > 5 % of the window (protocol 6.1 and 7.3); the other hardware flags fire on any packet. Not locked (G2).
